title: A refused or unreachable workspace WebSocket handshake is answered with its status, not a bare close the edge turns into 502
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/upgrade-listener.test.mjs
S2: Read the lines of the three tests whose names start with 'issue 888:'.
expect: 'issue 888: each refused handshake is answered with its status, never a bare close' reports ok: no database 503, no site 404, not signed in 401, no seat 403, token to re-mint 401, database failure 503, each with connection: close (pre-fix: socket.destroy() with no bytes).
'issue 888: dsh unreachable (a redeploy) answers 503 with retry-after, not a bare close' reports ok (pre-fix: the socket was destroyed with nothing written and the test timed out).

'issue 888: a refused socket that resets while its answer flushes is no uncaught error' reports ok: for each refusal, an `error` emitted on the socket after the listener returned does not throw and closes the socket (before review fix M1: the only `error` listener was taken off, and the emit threw ECONNRESET — an uncaught exception in tracy-web).
evidence: Measured 11/10/2026 on dev (tracy-dev, journalctl -u cloudflared): every failed wss://cowork.tracy.site/<site>/api/remote.mux was 'Unable to reach the origin service ... EOF' from 127.0.0.1:51710 (tracy-web), which the edge answers as 502 — a tab of a deleted site retrying every 14 s for an hour, and bursts at 13:26:09 exactly when tracy-dsh restarted for a deploy.
fence: apps/tracy-web/src/workspace/upgrade.js answers every refusal through refuseUpgrade; apps/tracy-web/src/workspace/proxy.js forwardUpgrade answers 503 when dsh fails before the splice; refuseUpgrade keeps an `error` listener on the socket while its answer flushes.

tests: issue 888: each refused handshake is answered with its status, never a bare close
issue 888: dsh unreachable (a redeploy) answers 503 with retry-after, not a bare close
issue 888: a refused socket that resets while its answer flushes is no uncaught error
